historical_significance: 美国心理学与实用主义哲学的双重奠基人，把心理学从内省玄学改造成可观察、可描述的自然科学，又把哲学从抽象体系拉回到对具体生活后果的追问。核心方法论：以『意识流』描述取代元素主义心理物理学的原子分解——意识是流动的、连续的、有选择功能的整体；以詹姆斯-朗格学说倒转情绪的因果链——我们不是因为悲伤而哭，而是因为哭而悲伤，把情绪还原为对身体变化的知觉；以习惯即神经通路的可塑性理论，把道德修养变成对神经回路的工程管理；以实用主义真理观把『真』定义为在经验之流中『行得通、可验证』的观念——真理不是静态的对应而是动态的兑现过程；以彻底经验主义把关系本身也纳入经验素材，拒绝在经验之外设任何形而上学实体；以《宗教经验之种种》示范对第一人称证词的博物学式采集——不问教义真假，只问宗教经验的效果与变体；以『信仰的意志』划定证据不足时理性仍可裁决的地带——在被迫的、活的、重大的选择面前，悬置本身就是一种冒险的选择；以多元论宇宙观对抗一元绝对论，把世界看作未完成、可增补的『多』；以『疲惫 beyond』的第二次呼吸观察，把人的能量储备从自认极限中解放出来。他把美国精神『以效果检验观念』提炼成一套可传授、可操作的方法论，同时以文学家的笔法示范了抽象论证如何写成人人可读的经验描述。
historical_significance_en: Dual founder of American psychology and pragmatist philosophy, who remade psychology from introspective metaphysics into an observable natural science, and pulled philosophy back from abstract systems to the concrete consequences of living. Core methodology: replacing elementalistic atomism with the 'stream of consciousness'—mind as a flowing, continuous, selecting whole; the James-Lange reversal of emotion's causal chain—we do not weep because we are sad but are sad because we weep, reducing emotion to the perception of bodily change; the theory of habit as neural plasticity, turning moral cultivation into engineering of neural pathways; the pragmatist theory of truth, defining 'true' as an idea that 'works and can be verified' in the stream of experience—truth as a dynamic cashing-in process, not static correspondence; radical empiricism, admitting relations themselves as items of experience and refusing any metaphysical entity beyond experience; The Varieties of Religious Experience as naturalist fieldwork on first-person testimony—asking not whether doctrine is true but what religious experiences do; 'The Will to Believe' mapping where reason may still decide when evidence runs out—before a forced, living, momentous option, suspending judgment is itself a risky choice; pluralism against monistic absolutism, the world as an unfinished 'many' open to addition; and the observation of 'second wind' beyond felt fatigue, releasing human energy reserves from self-imposed limits. He distilled the American spirit of 'testing ideas by their effects' into a teachable methodology, while showing with a literary pen how abstract argument can be written as description everyone can read.

modes.category: 科学方法论/研究对象重划
modes.domain_zh: 心理学对象重划/拒绝原子分解的整体描述
modes.domain_en: Redefining the Object of Psychology / Holistic Description against Atomism
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的根本困难是：冯特-铁钦纳的内省心理学把意识切成『感觉原子』再找联结规律，但内省者实际报告的从来不是原子，而是一条连续、流动、永远在变、有对象、有选择功能的流。他的解法不是修补原子论，而是重划研究对象：承认意识作为整体流的事实性——它与任何大脑过程共联（correlate），其五个特征（个人性、常变性、连续性、必有对象、有选择性）本身就是经验描述，无须先还原为元素再重建。方法上这意味着：当分析工具的分析单位造不出研究对象时，先怀疑分析单位而非对象——正确的第一步不是分解再综合，而是按现象所是的样子整体描述，再让分解去适配现象。描述先行于还原，是全部后来的机能主义、格式塔与现象学心理学的共同起点。
modes.definition_en: James faced a fundamental difficulty: Wundtian-Titchenerian introspectionism cut consciousness into 'sensation atoms' and then sought laws of association, but what introspectors actually reported was never atoms—it was a continuous, flowing, always-changing stream with an object and a selective function. His solution was not to patch atomism but to re-draw the object of study: acknowledge the factuality of consciousness as a holistic stream—it coexists (correlates) with any brain process, and its five characters (personal, changing, continuous, object-bearing, selective) are themselves descriptions of experience requiring no prior reduction to elements. Methodologically: when the analytic tool's unit cannot reconstruct the phenomenon, suspect the unit before the phenomenon—the right first move is not to decompose and re-synthesize but to describe the whole as it presents itself, and let decomposition fit the phenomenon. Description precedes reduction; this is the common starting point of functionalism, Gestalt, and phenomenological psychology.
modes.source_chapter: 《心理学原理》第九章『意识之流』：『意识在其自身之内并非链珠般节段的串联；把它描述为链条或列车是不当的——它是一条流』；意识五特征与『思想自身是连续的』论证
modes.key_quote_zh: 意识在其自身之内并非链珠般节段的串联；把它描述为链条或列车是不当的——它是一条流。
modes.key_quote_en: Consciousness, then, does not appear to itself chopped up in bits... It is nothing jointed; it flows. A 'river' or a 'stream' are the metaphors by which it is most naturally described.
process_zh: 拿到第一手现象报告后，先原样登记整体描述，检查它是否被现有分析单位强行切成了不属于它的碎片
若描述与分解冲突，先怀疑分解单位而非现象：列出该单位删除、压平或虚构了什么
重划分析单位：按现象自身呈现的连续性、方向性、选择性定单位（流、场、功能），而非按仪器方便定单位
让还原去适配描述：任何生理或机制层面的解释必须能回接整体描述的每个特征，接不上的特征保留为待解释项而非删除
process_en: On receiving first-hand phenomenal reports, register the holistic description as-is, checking whether existing analytic units have cut it into fragments not its own
Where description conflicts with decomposition, suspect the unit before the phenomenon: list what the unit deleted, flattened, or invented
Re-draw the unit of analysis by the phenomenon's own continuity, directedness, selectivity (stream, field, function), not by instrumental convenience

Make reduction fit description: every physiological or mechanistic explanation must hook back to each feature of the holistic description; features that cannot hook back stay as pending explananda, never deleted
representative_cases_zh: 《心理学原理》第九章用『感觉之和』悖论击破元素论：同一乐曲第二遍听来已不同（带了第一遍的记忆），感觉原子相加无法得出——意识的复合不是加法而是函数
『思想之流』中处理空隙（transitive parts）：意识两端由『关系感』接续，内省只看见实体感觉是因为只盯着名词不盯飞掠而过的关系——像抓住由旋转的螺旋桨构成的『虚空』
机能主义纲领：把『意识是什么』改为『意识有什么用』——意识是引导有机体适应的心理功能，心理学由此从结构学转向功能学
反例警示：铁钦纳康奈尔实验室把内省训练成『刺激-反应报告』，训练多年后受试者只能报告元素而非经验——分析单位越纯，离现象越远，整个构造心理学随其消亡
representative_cases_en: Chapter IX of the Principles breaks elementism with the 'sum of sensations' paradox: the same tune heard the second time is already different (carrying memory of the first)—adding sensation-atoms cannot yield this; mental compounding is a function, not an addition

In 'The Stream of Thought' James handles the transitive parts: the ends of thoughts are joined by 'feelings of relation,' which introspection misses because it watches nouns and not the fleeting relations—like catching a 'void' made of whirling blades
The functionalist program: change 'what is consciousness' into 'what is consciousness for'—mind as a guide to adaptation, psychology turning from structural to functional science

Cautionary case: Titchener's Cornell lab trained introspection into stimulus-response reporting until subjects could report only elements, never experience—the purer the analytic unit, the farther from the phenomenon; structuralism died with it
modern_applications_zh: 用户体验研究：以任务流与旅程图整体描述用户行为，拒绝把体验先切成点击原子再拼回——先看流，再谈漏斗
代码审查：先整体读一遍变更的意图与叙事，再逐行审查——按现象的整体形状定审查单位
访谈方法论：让受访者连续叙述而非逐题作答，分析时保留叙事的连续与转折，不把引语切成佐证原子
复杂系统观测：先记录系统的整体轨迹（流的形状），再选分解框架——防止监控面板的指标原子遮蔽系统行为
modern_applications_en: UX research: describe user behavior holistically as task flows and journey maps; do not slice experience into click-atoms and re-assemble—see the stream before the funnel
Code review: read the whole change once for intent and narrative before line-level review—set the review unit by the phenomenon's overall shape
Interview methodology: have subjects narrate continuously rather than answer item by item; in analysis keep narrative continuity and turns intact instead of cutting quotes into evidentiary atoms
Complex-system observation: record the system's overall trajectory (shape of the stream) before choosing a decomposition frame—stop metric-atoms on dashboards from eclipsing system behavior

modes.category: 科学方法论/因果链重排
modes.domain_zh: 因果链倒转/从知觉到身体反应再到情绪
modes.domain_en: Causal-Chain Reversal / From Perception via Bodily Response to Emotion
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：常识把情绪当作身体反应的原因——『我们遇见熊害怕，所以逃跑；我们悲伤，所以流泪』——但这个次序无法检验，情绪成了一种不可分析的神秘现量。他的解法是倒转被默认的因果链：知觉到刺激性事实→身体跟着起变化（心跳、颤抖、逃跑动作）→对这些身体变化的『知觉』就是情绪本身。『我们不是因为害怕而逃跑，而是因为逃跑而害怕；不是因为悲伤而流泪，而是因为流泪而悲伤。』方法上这意味着：当一对现象的先后次序是常识默认、从未被检验时，把次序倒过来做思想实验与检验——若倒转后每个现象反而变得可分析（情绪分解为对身体状态的感知、不同情绪对应不同身体模式），倒转就揭示了被常识次序掩盖的机制。因果链上被『想当然』的箭头，往往正是理论上最薄弱、信息量最大的那一支。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: common sense makes emotion the cause of bodily reaction—'we meet a bear, feel fear, and run; we grieve, and so we weep'—but this order is untestable, leaving emotion an unanalyzable mystery. His solution was to reverse the assumed causal chain: perception of the exciting fact → bodily changes follow (heartbeat, trembling, flight) → the perception of these bodily changes is the emotion itself. 'We do not weep because we are sorry, but we are sorry because we weep.' Methodologically: when the order of two phenomena is common-sense default and never tested, reverse it as a thought experiment and a test—if the reversal makes each phenomenon analyzable (emotion decomposes into perception of bodily state; distinct emotions map to distinct bodily patterns), the reversal has exposed the mechanism the common-sense order concealed. The arrow on a causal chain taken for granted is usually the weakest link and the richest in information.
modes.source_chapter: 《心理学原理》第二十五章『情绪』：『我们因为颤抖而恐惧，因为打而愤怒』；身体反应次序论证与『没有身体状态的纯粹情绪是空洞的』推论
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们不是因为害怕而逃跑，而是因为逃跑而害怕；不是因为悲伤而流泪，而是因为流泪而悲伤。
modes.key_quote_en: My theory ... is that the bodily changes follow directly the perception of the exciting fact, and that our feeling of the same changes as they occur IS the emotion.
process_zh: 写出常识版的因果链（情绪→身体反应），标注每一支箭头的证据来源——通常会发现次序箭头从未被独立检验过
把未检验的箭头倒转，做思想实验：倒转后原来不可分析的现象是否变成可分析、可分类、可对照
寻找独立证据裁决两个次序：生理实验（如脊髓损伤者情绪残存度调查）、病理案例（无身体反馈时情绪是否衰减）
接受检验后的新次序，并追认其推广边界——倒转解释了什么、不解释什么（如 James 承认理智性的审美与道德情感更难归入身体知觉）
process_en: Write out the common-sense causal chain (emotion → bodily reaction) and annotate the evidence for each arrow—usually the ordering arrow has never been independently tested
Reverse the untested arrow as a thought experiment: does the reversal make the previously unanalyzable phenomenon analyzable, classifiable, comparable?

Adjudicate the two orders with independent evidence: physiological experiment (e.g., surveys of emotional residue in spinal-injury patients), pathological cases (does emotion attenuate without bodily feedback?)

Accept the tested order and map its boundary of application—what the reversal explains and what it does not (James conceded intellectual aesthetic and moral emotions fit bodily perception less neatly)
representative_cases_zh: 1884《情绪是什么？》与1885丹麦生理学家朗格独立提出同一倒转——两个互不知情的倒转同时成立，成为『詹姆斯-朗格学说』
Sherrington 脊髓犬与 Cannon 的内脏剥离实验针对该学说证伪：内脏反馈减少后情绪行为仍在——詹姆斯预先用『内脏之外还有骨骼肌反馈』部分设防
当代具身认知的证据回收：面部反馈（咬笔诱导微笑评分）、恐惧中的心跳加速先于恐惧报告——倒转的部分机制在百年后重新获得支持
反例警示：Cannon-Bard 以丘脑同时发放说取而代之，但若把『同时发放』当作新的想当然箭头不设检验，倒转的教训就白学了——任何因果次序都应悬置于检验之前
representative_cases_en: In 1884 'What Is an Emotion?' and in 1885 the Danish physiologist Lange independently proposed the same reversal—together becoming the James-Lange theory, two blind reversals converging

Sherrington's spinal dogs and Cannon's viscera-stripping experiments refuted the theory: emotional behavior persisted with reduced visceral feedback—James had partially pre-armed with 'skeletal-muscle feedback beyond the viscera'
Modern embodiment evidence reclaimed: facial feedback (pen-in-teeth smile ratings), heart-rate rise preceding fear reports—parts of the reversal regained support a century later

Cautionary case: Cannon-Bard replaced it with simultaneous thalamic discharge—but making that the new assumed arrow without testing would squander the lesson: every causal order stays suspended until tested
modern_applications_zh: 行为设计：把『先有动力再行动』倒转为『先行动，动力随之而来』——5分钟启动法、行为激活疗法
组织诊断：把『文化决定行为』倒转检验——先改流程与物理环境再观察文化是否随之改变
产品分析：把『需求驱动使用』倒转——检查是否是使用动作塑造了需求感知（先试用后认同）
沟通训练：以身体先行调节心理状态（姿势、呼吸、走动）再处理认知内容，而不是先讲道理
modern_applications_en: Behavior design: reverse 'motivation precedes action' into 'act first, motivation follows'—the five-minute start, behavioral activation therapy
Organizational diagnosis: test-reverse 'culture drives behavior'—change process and physical environment first, then observe whether culture follows
Product analysis: reverse 'need drives usage'—check whether usage actions shape need perception (trial before endorsement)
Communication training: regulate psychological state via the body first (posture, breath, walking) before addressing cognitive content, rather than reasoning first

modes.domain_zh: 自我改造/把习惯还原为神经物质与可设计流程
modes.domain_en: Self-Remodeling / Reducing Habit to Neural Matter and a Designable Procedure
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：道德劝诫把习惯当作意志力的直接产物，而意志反复失败——人知道该早起、该戒酒，行为却不变。他的解法是把习惯从道德范畴移交给生理与工程范畴：习惯是神经系统为削减意识负荷而形成的放电通路——『习惯是社会的巨大飞轮』，神经系统的可塑性意味着通路一旦刻下就倾向于自我维持。由此道德修养变成通路工程：趁神经可塑性最高的青年期刻下尽量多的好通路；启动新习惯时不靠意志每天重新决断，而靠一次性的、不可逆的环境布置（『每天在无关紧要处刻意做一次意志练习』是通路维护体操）；别给自己留退路（Benjamin Franklin 式的自我约束）。方法上这意味着：行为改变的杠杆不在每一次的决心强度，而在通路刻下的初始条件——把改变从重复消耗意志的战斗改造成一次性设计的问题。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: moral exhortation treats habit as a direct product of willpower, yet will fails repeatedly—people know they should rise early or quit drinking, but behavior does not change. His solution: move habit from the moral category to the physiological-engineering one—habit is a discharge pathway the nervous system forms to cut the load on consciousness—'habit is the enormous fly-wheel of society'; neural plasticity means a pathway, once carved, tends to sustain itself. Moral cultivation thus becomes pathway engineering: carve as many good pathways as possible in youth, when plasticity peaks; launch a new habit not by re-deciding daily with willpower but by one-time, irreversible arrangement of the environment ('keep the faculty of effort alive by a deliberate gratuitous exercise every day' as pathway-maintenance drill); leave yourself no line of retreat. Methodologically: the lever of behavior change lies not in the intensity of each resolution but in the initial conditions of pathway-carving—turning change from a battle that re-spends willpower into a one-shot design problem.
modes.source_chapter: 《心理学原理》第四章『习惯』：『习惯是神经物质被外力刻下的可塑性印记』；『习惯是社会的巨大飞轮』；实用格言三条（刻通路趁早、一次发动不留退路、每天练意志）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们的生活在某种意义上说，直到生命的尽头，也不过是把更多的习惯刻进神经物质的过程。
modes.key_quote_en: Could the young but realize how soon they will become mere walking bundles of habits, they would give more heed to their conduct while in the plastic state.
process_zh: 把目标行为还原为通路问题：识别要刻下的新通路、要废除的旧通路，以及两者相互触发的环境线索
一次性布置刻通路的初始条件：物理环境、时间锚点、社会承诺——设计成不可逆或撤销成本极高
抓住关键节点全力发动：新习惯的最初几次执行动用最大决心与资源（『不留退路』原则），此后靠通路自我维持
日常维护与反刻痕：每天在无关紧要的小事上做一次刻意练习保持意志通路可用；监控旧通路的复发线索并及时修补环境
process_en: Reduce the target behavior to a pathway problem: identify the new pathway to carve, the old one to abolish, and the environmental cues that trigger each
Arrange one-shot initial conditions for carving: physical environment, time anchors, social commitments—designed to be irreversible or prohibitively costly to undo
Launch with full force at the critical node: spend maximum willpower and resources on the first few executions ('no line of retreat'), then let the pathway self-sustain
Maintain daily and guard against re-carving: a deliberate trivial exercise daily keeps the effort-pathway available; monitor relapse cues of the old pathway and patch the environment promptly
representative_cases_zh: 詹姆斯引用 M. Léon Dumont 的酒徒案例：无法改变环境的酒徒难戒，环境一换（离开旧酒馆）恶习不攻自破——刻痕依附于环境线索
他自己终身践行：清晨冷水浴与晨间决断练习（『起床即刻起身，不让退路出现』），把哲学家的自律建成通路工程
《与教师谈心理学》把习惯论转成教育建议：教师的责任是趁可塑性窗口帮学生自动刻下正确通路，习惯自动化即道德的生理基础
反例警示：只靠每日重申决心的自我改造（日记式立志）在詹姆斯案例库中反复失败——意志被当作每日消耗品而非一次性投入的初始条件，通路从未刻下
representative_cases_en: James quotes M. Léon Dumont's drunkard case: the drunkard who cannot change his milieu cannot reform; once the environment changes (leaving the old tavern), the vice dissolves—the engraving clings to environmental cues
He practiced it lifelong: morning cold baths and the morning-resolution drill ('rise instantly on waking; never allow a line of retreat')—a philosopher's self-discipline built as pathway engineering

Talks to Teachers converts habit theory into pedagogy: the teacher's duty is to carve correct pathways automatically during the plasticity window—habit automatization as the physiological basis of morality

Cautionary case: self-reform relying on daily reaffirmed resolutions (diary-style resolves) fails repeatedly in James's casebook—willpower treated as a daily consumable rather than a one-shot initial condition; the pathway is never carved
modern_applications_zh: 习惯应用设计：习惯堆叠+环境线索改造（把跑鞋放门口、卸载入口应用），一次布置替代每日决心
戒断项目：把旧通路的触发线索逐项移除而非依赖抵抗意志——戒烟先清空烟具与常去场所
教学与培训：把技能练习安排在可塑性最高的早期集中刻通路，后期只做维护性复习
组织流程：用不可逆的流程设计（签批顺序、默认选项）替代道德倡议——把合规建成组织的『飞轮』
modern_applications_en: Habit-app design: habit stacking plus cue re-engineering (running shoes at the door, uninstalling entry apps)—one-time arrangement replacing daily resolve
Quitting programs: remove old-pathway triggers item by item rather than relying on resisting willpower—clear all smoking paraphernalia and haunts before quitting
Teaching and training: concentrate practice early, when plasticity peaks, to carve pathways; later stages only maintain with review
Organizational process: replace moral exhortation with irreversible process design (approval order, default options)—build compliance as the organization's 'fly-wheel'

modes.category: 哲学方法论/真理观重定
modes.domain_zh: 真理重定/以经验后果与可兑现性检验观念
modes.domain_en: Redefining Truth / Testing Ideas by Experiential Consequences and Cash Value
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：真理的对应论把『真』当作观念与实在的静态符合，但这种符合本身无法验证——争论双方各自宣称符合，争论永无裁决。他的解法是把真理从名词变成动词：一个观念为真，指的是它在经验之流中『行得通』——引导我们与经验的其余部分建立满意的、可核验的关系。『真观念是我们能够消化、证实、确认和核验的观念；假观念是我们不能的。』真理不是观念固有的惰性属性，而是『发生到观念头上的事情』：真理由验证事件制造出来。方法上这意味着：面对僵持的观念之争，不问『谁符合实在』而问『各自若为真，我们在经验中会遭遇到什么差别』——差别可检验者裁决之，无差别者（皮尔士意义下的形而上差别）悬置之。抽象真理的价值在于『兑现价值』（cash value）——能兑换成具体的、可操作的经验后果才算数。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: the correspondence theory treats 'true' as a static agreement between idea and reality, yet such agreement itself cannot be verified—each side of a dispute claims it, and the dispute is never settled. His solution: turn truth from a noun into a verb—an idea is true insofar as it 'works' in the stream of experience, guiding us into satisfactory, verifiable relations with other parts of experience. 'True ideas are those that we can assimilate, validate, corroborate and verify. False ideas are those that we cannot.' Truth is not an inert property of ideas but 'something that happens to an idea': truths are made by verification-events. Methodologically: in a deadlocked dispute over ideas, ask not 'which matches reality' but 'what experiential difference would follow if each were true'—adjudicate where the difference is testable; suspend where there is no difference (Peirce's metaphysical distinctions). Abstract truth's worth is its cash value—countable only when convertible into concrete, operable experiential consequences.
modes.source_chapter: 《实用主义》第二讲与第六讲『实用主义的真理概念』：『真观念是我们能够消化、证实、确认和核验的观念』；『真理的兑现价值』与信用货币类比
modes.key_quote_zh: 真观念是我们能够消化、证实、确认和核验的观念；假观念则是我们不能的。
modes.key_quote_en: True ideas are those that we can assimilate, validate, corroborate and verify. False ideas are those that we cannot.
process_zh: 把争论中的观念各自翻译为具体的经验后果：『若此观念为真，我将预期遭遇什么』——列出可兑现的差别清单
逐项检验差别清单：设计或指认能对差别作出裁决的经验事件（验证、证伪、预测兑现）
对已兑现的观念保持信念账本：真理像信用货币一样流通，持续以新经验兑付；无法继续兑付的观念贬值重估
对无经验差别的争辩（纯形而上差别）执行悬置：宣布其为字面之争而非事实之争，拒绝让其占用裁决资源
process_en: Translate each contested idea into concrete experiential consequences: 'if this idea were true, what should I expect to encounter'—list the cashable differences
Test the list item by item: design or identify experiential events that adjudicate the difference (verification, falsification, prediction cashing in)
Keep a belief ledger for cashed-in ideas: truth circulates like credit currency, continually redeemed by new experience; ideas that stop cashing are devalued and re-estimated
For disputes with no experiential difference (purely metaphysical ones), suspend: declare them verbal, not factual, and refuse to let them consume adjudication resources
representative_cases_zh: 信用货币类比：真理如币，其值在于能被经验『兑付』——『真理的债票』被未来经验兑现，观念的网络相互担保（这是对对应论最著名的替换论证）
『松林与枫林』例：『松树在哪一边』由谁先走哪条路验证——方向观念的真在于引领到达，不在静态摹写
用实用主义准则重述上帝观念：『上帝存在』的差别在于生命预期与行动气质的具体改变——拒绝只争论定义而不列后果的空转神学
反例警示：罗素与摩尔指控实用主义把『有用即真』——詹姆斯回应是『长远看令人满意的引导方式』且包含与实在的核对环节，并非以愿望代替验证；但通俗化传播中该误解反复发生，准则必须带上『可验证』限定词使用
representative_cases_en: The credit-currency analogy: truth is like money, its value lying in being redeemed by experience—'truth's drafts' cashed by future experience, the web of ideas mutually endorsing (his most famous replacement for correspondence)
The pines-and-maples example: 'which side the pines are on' is verified by which path you take—the directional idea is true by leading you there, not by static copying

Restating the God-idea by the pragmatic maxim: the difference of 'God exists' lies in concrete changes in life-expectation and moral temper—refusing theology that argues definitions without listing consequences

Cautionary case: Russell and Moore charged pragmatism with 'useful = true'—James replied it means 'satisfactorily guiding over the long run' and includes a checking-against-reality step, not wish in place of verification; yet the misreading recurs in vulgarized use—the maxim must always carry the 'verifiable' qualifier
modern_applications_zh: 产品决策：以 A/B 测试的转化差异裁决设计之争——无经验差别的美学争论记录为字面分歧不占测试资源
理论评估：以『预测兑现清单』评估学术范式——新理论必须列出与旧理论不同的可观察后果
战略复盘：检验战略假设『若为真我们应看到什么』，把战略辩论从立场之争转为后果清单之争
个人学习：只承认能兑换为行动改变的『知道』——读书后列出行为差别清单并逐项兑现
modern_applications_en: Product decisions: adjudicate design disputes by A/B-test conversion differences—log aesthetic disputes with no experiential difference as verbal, spending no test resources
Theory evaluation: assess research paradigms by 'prediction cash-in lists'—a new theory must list observable consequences differing from the old
Strategy retrospectives: test strategic assumptions by 'if true, what should we observe,' turning strategy debates from position wars into consequence-list wars
Personal learning: admit as 'known' only what converts into behavioral change—after reading, list behavioral deltas and cash them in one by one

modes.name_zh: 彻底经验主义关系内收法
modes.category: 哲学方法论/经验边界重划
modes.domain_zh: 认识论边界重划/把关系与过渡并入经验素材
modes.domain_en: Redrawing Epistemic Boundaries / Admitting Relations into Experience Itself
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：传统经验论（休谟式）承认的『经验』只有离散的感觉印象，观念间的联结（因果、同一、类似）必须由经验之外的『心灵』或『知性』提供——于是联结成了形而上学的私货，经验成了碎片，需要外部黏合剂。他的解法是扩大经验的地界而非在经验外设黏合剂：彻底经验主义宣言——(1) 后件论：只承认能用经验项解释的哲学结论；(2) 关系项也是直接经验：『接续感』『同一感』『趋向感』本身是被经验到的素材，与颜色、声音同权。意识流中的过渡部分（transitive parts）就是证据：思想由关系感接续，我们只是通常只盯着名词漏看了。方法上这意味着：当理论被迫在经验之外引入担保者（实体、自我、知性、范畴），先检查被经验论『裁掉』的素材里是否本就含有被否认的联结——经验的地界常被分析工具画小了。扩充素材，而不是雇佣形而上学保镖。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: classical empiricism (Humean) admitted as 'experience' only discrete sensory impressions, so the links between ideas (causation, identity, likeness) had to be supplied by something outside experience—a 'mind' or 'understanding'—making connection a metaphysical smuggled good and experience fragments needing external glue. His solution: enlarge experience's territory rather than hire glue from outside it. The radical-empiricist program—(1) the postulate: only philosophical conclusions explicable by experiential items; (2) relations are themselves direct experience: feelings of 'and,' 'if,' 'by' are experienced data, on equal footing with colors and sounds. The transitive parts of the stream of consciousness are the evidence: thoughts are joined by feelings of relation, which we miss by watching only the nouns. Methodologically: when a theory is forced to introduce a guarantor beyond experience (substance, self, understanding, categories), first check whether the material the empiricist 'cut away' already contained the denied connections—the boundary of experience is usually drawn too small by the analytic tool. Enlarge the material rather than hire a metaphysical bodyguard.
modes.source_chapter: 《彻底经验主义论文集》第一篇『彻底经验主义』：后件论、事实论与关系内收纲领；《心理学原理》第九章『思想的关系感』（transitive parts 论证）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我同样把关系当作直接经验的一部分——『和』『如果』『经由』的感觉与『蓝』的感觉同为经验素材。
modes.key_quote_en: To be radical, an empiricism must neither admit into its constructions any element that is not directly experienced, nor exclude from them any element that is directly experienced.
process_zh: 审计理论的『经验之外担保者』清单：实体、自我、范畴、先验联结——每项都问『为经验内部哪个现象作保』
回到第一手经验素材，专门收集被分析工具裁掉的过渡与联结片段：接续感、趋向感、同一感是否被经验到
把收集到的关系素材内收为合法经验项，重画经验边界：联结不再需要外部担保者，碎片理论的外聘黏合剂随之裁员
检验新边界的解释力：原需担保者解释的现象是否全部由扩充后的经验项覆盖；残留缺口如实保留为开放问题而非重聘保镖
process_en: Audit the theory's list of extra-experiential guarantors—substance, self, categories, synthetic connections—asking of each 'what phenomenon inside experience does it underwrite?'

Return to first-hand experiential material and specifically collect the transitional and connective fragments the analytic tool cut away: are feelings of sequence, of tendency, of identity actually experienced?

Internalize the collected relational material as legitimate experiential items and redraw experience's boundary: connection needs no external guarantor; the hired glue of fragment-theories is laid off

Test the new boundary's explanatory power: are all phenomena once covered by guarantors now covered by the enlarged experiential items? Honest residual gaps stay open questions—no re-hiring bodyguards
representative_cases_zh: 『和』的感觉论证：读者连读 'and' 与连读 'or' 时口腔发音与意识氛围不同——关系有可经验的质地，休谟把它裁掉是因为只收『印象的原子』
意识流中的过渡部分论证（承接 M-WJM-001）：思想的接续由飞掠的关系感完成——像抓住由旋转螺旋桨构成的『虚空』；截屏式内省漏看联结，反诬经验无联结
纯粹经验双面性：同一『纯粹经验』既被算作物理世界的一节又被算作心灵的一节——主客二分是经验项的归类而非两个实体的存在论划分
反例警示：马赫的感觉要素论同样反实体，但把关系也还原为感觉要素的排列，重建了新的原子主义——边界重划若不同时扩容联结素材，会以新形式重犯旧病
representative_cases_en: The feeling of 'and': reading 'and' and reading 'or' leave different oral-utterance and conscious atmospheres—relations have experienceable texture; Hume cut them away only by admitting 'atomic impressions' alone

The transitive-parts argument (continuing M-WJM-001): thoughts are joined by fleeting feelings of relation, like catching a 'void' made of whirling blades; screenshot-style introspection misses the links and then falsely accuses experience of having none

Pure experience's double aspect: the same pure experience figures as one section of the physical world and as one section of mind—subject-object split is a classification of experiential items, not an ontological division of two substances

Cautionary case: Mach's sensation-elements also reject substance but reduce relations to arrangements of elements, re-erecting a new atomism—redrawing the boundary without simultaneously enlarging connective material repeats the old disease in new form
modern_applications_zh: 定性研究：把访谈中的连接词、停顿、转折语当作一等数据收进编码本，而非只编码『实词内容』
数据建模：检查特征工程是否把序列关系（时序、因果方向）裁掉只剩静态特征——先把关系本身建成一等公民
系统设计：接口契约（关系）与数据（内容）同权版本化——防止只管内容不管联结的集成腐化
知识组织：笔记系统保留段落间的『为什么相连』批注，防止链接成为无内容的联结假象
modern_applications_en: Qualitative research: admit connectives, pauses, and discourse markers into the codebook as first-class data, not just 'content words'
Data modeling: check whether feature engineering cut away sequential relations (temporal order, causal direction) leaving static features only—make relations themselves first-class citizens
System design: version interface contracts (relations) with the same standing as data (contents)—prevent integration rot that manages contents but not connections
Knowledge organization: keep 'why linked' annotations between note passages, preventing links from becoming content-free imitations of connection

modes.name_en: Naturalist Fieldwork on Religious Experience Method
modes.category: 科学方法论/第一人称证词采集
modes.domain_zh: 宗教心理学/对皈依与圣徒性经验的博物学式采集分类
modes.domain_en: Psychology of Religion / Naturalist Collection and Typology of Conversion and Saintliness
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：宗教研究被两个阵营瓜分——神学家只承认本教教义、把异己经验当病态；医学唯物论者把一切宗教经验当神经病症状一笔勾销。两边都不『看』经验本身。他的解法是坚持彻底经验主义的『不裁断原则』——对第一人称宗教证词执行博物学家的态度：像采集植物标本一样采集圣徒传记、皈依叙事、神秘状态报告，只做描述、分类、分期，不问教义形而上学真假，只问这些经验的直接后果（圣徒性的生活果实：耐心、慈善、勇气）与变体谱系（渐进皈依 vs 突然皈依、健康心态 vs 病态灵魂）。方法上这意味着：面对被立场瓜分的现象，用博物学方法开辟第三条路——先把证词当作待采标本而非待审案件，以 fruit（果实）而非 root（根源）为分类判据，等谱系清楚了再谈解释。『以果实检验教义』同时是对两个阵营的方法论反击。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: the study of religion was split between theologians, who admitted only their own doctrine and treated alien experiences as pathology, and medical materialists, who wrote off all religious experience as neural symptoms. Neither side actually looked at the experience itself. His solution: apply radical empiricism's no-block principle to first-person religious testimony—the naturalist's stance, collecting saints' lives, conversion narratives, and mystical-state reports like botanical specimens; describe, classify, and stage them, asking neither doctrinal-metaphysical truth nor pathological origin, only the fruits (saintliness: patience, charity, courage) and the variant spectrum (gradual vs sudden conversion, healthy-mindedness vs the sick soul). Methodologically: for phenomena partitioned by partisan stances, open a third way with the naturalist method—treat testimony as specimen to be collected, not case to be tried; classify by fruits, not roots; talk of explanation only after the spectrum is clear. 'Judge doctrine by fruits' strikes methodologically at both camps at once.
modes.source_chapter: 《宗教经验之种种》第一讲『宗教与神经学』与最后讲『圣徒性的品格』：『要判断圣徒型的性格，须以其果实而非其根源来评判』；健康心态与病态灵魂的分类
modes.key_quote_zh: 评判圣徒性格，当以其果实而非其根源为准——「凭他们的果子，就可以认出他们来」。
modes.key_quote_en: By their fruits ye shall know them, not by their roots.
process_zh: 划定证词采集范围：搜罗第一人称宗教/极端经验报告（自传、圣徒传记、访谈、病历），不带立场预筛——病态的与神圣的都收
只做描述与分类登记：按经验结构（皈依路径、意识状态变化、世界观翻转）建立谱系，悬置真伪与病源判断
以果实为分类与评价判据：追踪经验的生活后果（品格改变、行动模式、对待他人的方式），以果实质量比较变体
谱系清楚后再谈解释：让心理学、生理学解释竞争出场，但解释不得回头删除证词——果实未被推翻的证词持续有效
process_en: Scope the testimony corpus: gather first-person reports of religious/limit experiences (autobiographies, saints' lives, interviews, case records) with no stance-based pre-filter—collect the pathological and the holy alike
Only describe and classify: build a spectrum by experiential structure (conversion path, state change, worldview reversal), suspending truth and etiology
Use fruits as the criterion of classification and evaluation: track life-consequences (character change, action patterns, treatment of others), compare variants by fruit quality
Admit explanation only after the spectrum is clear: let psychological and physiological explanations compete, but no explanation may delete testimony—accounts with unrefuted fruits remain valid
representative_cases_zh: 对医学唯物论的正面回击（第一讲）：『圣特蕾莎是歇斯底里患者』的医学解释就算全对，也回答不了『她的果实为何是圣洁生活』——根源解释与果实评价是两个问题
病态灵魂 vs 健康心态的谱系：托尔斯泰《忏悔录》式的抑郁翻转与爱默生式的阳光皈依被并列为两种宗教气质——病态气质反而在深度上占优，这是对『病态即伪』的分类学反驳
『另一种意识秩序』的采集：神秘状态的四个标记（不可言说、知悟性、暂时性、被动性）从数十份证词中归纳——先有标本后有定义
反例警示：后来的宗教社会学以问卷调查宗教归属替代证词采集，得到的是身份标签而非经验流——方法从博物学退回统计，詹姆斯式的谱系（皈依结构、意识变体）从此失传于主流测量
representative_cases_en: The frontal reply to medical materialism (Lecture I): even if 'Saint Teresa was a hysteric' were entirely true as medicine, it still does not answer why her fruits were a holy life—root-explanation and fruit-evaluation are two different questions

The spectrum of the sick soul vs healthy-mindedness: Tolstoy's depressed reversal in A Confession and Emerson's sunny conversion are classified as two religious temperaments—and the sick temperament ranks deeper, a taxonomic rebuttal of 'pathological therefore false'

Collecting 'other orders of consciousness': the four marks of mystical states (ineffability, noetic quality, transiency, passivity) induced from dozens of testimonies—specimens first, definition after

Cautionary case: later sociology of religion replaced testimony with affiliation questionnaires, harvesting identity labels instead of experience-streams—the method regressed from naturalism to statistics, and Jamesian spectra (conversion structure, variants of consciousness) were lost to mainstream measurement
modern_applications_zh: 用户极端体验研究：采集极端好评与极端投诉的第一人称叙事建谱系，以行为后果（留存/推荐）而非立场评价变体
医学人文：以果实判据评价替代疗法与信仰疗法——解释机制悬置，生活质量与功能后果进入评价
危机干预：对极端体验（濒死、解离、狂喜）先描述登记不先病理化，按功能后果分流处理
组织文化研究：采集创始叙事与转折事件的第一人称证词建文化谱系，以行为果实而非墙上标语评判
modern_applications_en: Extreme-experience UX research: collect first-person narratives of extreme praise and extreme complaint into a spectrum; judge variants by behavioral fruits (retention, referral), not stance
Medical humanities: evaluate alternative and faith therapies by fruit criteria—suspend mechanism debates, admit quality-of-life and functional outcomes
Crisis intervention: describe and register extreme experiences (near-death, dissociation, ecstasy) before pathologizing; triage by functional consequences
Organizational culture research: collect first-person founder narratives and turning-point testimonies into a culture spectrum; judge by behavioral fruits, not wall slogans

modes.domain_zh: 证据不足时的决策分区/被迫-活的-重大选择判准
modes.domain_en: Partitioning Decisions under Undecidability / The Forced-Living-Momentous Criterion
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：克利福德律令『在证据不足时相信任何东西，无论何时何地都是错的』把全部信念问题交给证据悬置处理——但詹姆斯指出『悬置』不是中立选项：在被迫的、活的、重大的选择面前，拒绝选择本身就是一次有后果的赌注（如：与人合作前是否先信任对方；绝症面前是否相信治疗有意义）。证据不可能先于生活覆盖全部选择，等待证据的悬置在重大事务上等于把决定权交给怯懦。他的解法是给决策分区而非一刀切：技术上证据可裁决的归科学；非被迫的（可以回避的）选择悬置无代价；唯有当选择同时满足『被迫的』（不能回避）、『活的』（两个选项对你是真实活选项）、『重大的』（机会唯一、后果不可逆）三判准，且是情感性/实践性事务时，『信仰的意志』合法启动——以生命押注式的信念去创造其自身的证据（信任引出可信行为即为例证：你先信我，我于是可信）。方法上这意味着：决策纪律不是单一律令而是分区地图——先判决策类型，再选决策规则。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: Clifford's rule—'it is wrong always, everywhere, and for anyone, to believe anything upon insufficient evidence'—hands every question of belief to evidential suspension; yet James showed suspension is not a neutral option: before a forced, living, momentous option, refusing to choose is itself a consequential wager (e.g., whether to trust a collaborator before trusting is proven; whether to believe treatment is meaningful facing a terminal illness). Evidence cannot precede life across all choices; on the great matters, waiting is surrendering the decision to timidity. His solution: partition decisions rather than legislate one rule—where evidence can adjudicate, science; where the option can be avoided (not forced), suspension costs nothing; only when the option is simultaneously forced (cannot be avoided), living (both horns are genuinely alive to you), and momentous (unique, irreversible) in an emotional-practical matter may the will to believe lawfully activate—committing belief that creates its own evidence (trust evoking trustworthiness: you trust me first, and thereby I become trustworthy). Methodologically: decision discipline is not one commandment but a partition map—first classify the decision type, then choose the rule.
modes.source_chapter: 《信仰的意志》第一篇『信仰的意志』：克利福德律令批判；『被迫的-活的-重大的』三分判准；『怀疑即是一种冒险，与信仰的冒险无异』
modes.key_quote_zh: 在被迫的、活的、重大的选择面前，拒绝选择本身就是一种冒险的选择——怀疑论并非免于赌注，它同样是押注。
modes.key_quote_en: A rule of thinking which would absolutely prevent me from acknowledging certain kinds of truth if those kinds of truth were really there, would be an irrational rule.
process_zh: 先把决策分类：列出当下选择是否可回避（非被迫可悬置）、两个选项是否都是真实活选项（先剔除死项）、机会是否唯一且后果不可逆（重大）
对可被证据裁决的技术性部分，一律交付证据检验程序，禁止信仰意志侵入科学领地
对同时满足被迫-活的-重大、且属情感/实践性事务的选择，承认悬置本身即押注：比较『相信』与『悬置』两种赌注的后果分布后作出信念承诺
为信念承诺设计自证回路：让信念诱发出能产生其自身证据的行动（信任引出可信、热忱引出成就），并设定证伪检查点防止自证滑入妄想
process_en: First classify the decision: is the choice avoidable (if not forced, suspending costs nothing), are both horns genuinely alive (dead options pruned first), is the opportunity unique and irreversible (momentous)?
For the technically decidable parts, hand everything to evidential procedure—never let the will to believe invade science's territory

For choices simultaneously forced, living, and momentous in an emotional-practical matter, acknowledge that suspension itself is a wager: compare the consequence-distributions of believing and suspending, then commit

Design a self-verifying loop for the commitment: let belief elicit actions that generate its own evidence (trust evoking trustworthiness, zeal evoking achievement), with falsification checkpoints so self-verification never slides into delusion
representative_cases_zh: 社交信任案例：『我是否该信任新伙伴』无先验证据可裁决，且不信任的悬置已在制造敌意气氛——詹姆斯以此论证信任信念的自证性（先信任→对方接住→信任成真）
绝症患者的求生信念：证据对『治疗是否有意义』不裁决，悬置的消沉本身压垮免疫功能与治疗依从性——重大且被迫的选择上，希望是合法的信念工程
对克利福德的正面反驳：『要求证据完备再生活的人，在证据完备之前已经死了』——被证明为真的科学命题当初也是先被猜中再被证明（阿基米德式的先行赌注）
反例警示：信徒以同一论证为任何教条辩护（『你先信就明白了』）——判准缺了『活的』检验与自证回路的证伪检查点：若信念无法产生独立可核查的果实证据，分区法退化为通往妄想与狂热的特快通行证
representative_cases_en: The social-trust case: 'should I trust my new partner' has no a priori evidence, and mistrustful suspension is already manufacturing hostility—James's paradigm of self-verifying belief (trust first → the partner catches it → trust becomes true)

The dying patient's will to live: evidence does not adjudicate 'whether treatment is meaningful,' and suspended despair itself crushes immune function and compliance—on the momentous and forced, hope is lawful belief-engineering
The frontal reply to Clifford: 'he who demands proofs before living dies before they arrive'—even proven scientific truths were first conjectured against no proof (Archimedean advance wagers)

Cautionary case: believers reuse the same argument for any dogma ('believe first and you will see')—the criterion then lacks the 'living' test and the loop's falsification checkpoints: where belief yields no independently checkable fruit-evidence, the partition method degrades into an express pass to delusion and fanaticism
modern_applications_zh: 创业决策：创始人对无证据可裁决的愿景承诺（被迫-活的-重大），以信念承诺动员资源并设里程碑证伪点
合作谈判：先释放有限信任试探自证回路（信任引出守信），而非等待对方先自证
医疗沟通：对不可逆治疗决策向患者如实分区——技术可裁决项交数据，意义层面承认悬置有代价，由患者价值权重决断
心理治疗：行为激活中对『行动有无意义』的信念先行——先按若其为真行动，让后果回填信念
modern_applications_en: Entrepreneurship: founders commit belief to vision claims no evidence can yet adjudicate (forced-living-momentous), mobilizing resources while setting milestone falsification points
Negotiation: release limited trust first to test the self-verifying loop (trust evoking trustworthiness) instead of waiting for the other side to prove itself

Medical communication: partition irreversible treatment decisions honestly for patients—data-decidable items to evidence, the meaning-layer's cost of suspension acknowledged, settled by the patient's value weights
Psychotherapy: in behavioral activation, belief precedes action on 'does action matter'—act as if true, and let consequences backfill the belief

modes.category: 哲学方法论/世界观设定
modes.domain_zh: 形而上学设定/以未完成的多对抗一元绝对论
modes.domain_en: Metaphysical Stance / The Unfinished Many against Monistic Absolutism
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：绝对唯心论（布莱德雷、罗伊斯式）以『全体大于部分之和、部分唯有在整体中才有意义』论证宇宙是单个完成的绝对——局部恶、局部错误都被『更高的统一』消化掉。这个论证结构优雅却不可检验，且在实践上瘫痪行动：既然一切已在绝对中被安排，努力与责任都成了幻觉。他的解法是把『世界是完成的一』降格为未检验假设，代之以与之等价的未完成假设：世界是多元的『多』，既有的统一只是已形成的部分联结，未来开放、可增补、可拯救也可靠灾难。『世界可能正在被拯救』与『世界已完满』解释现有事实同样好，但前者保留行动的意义。方法上这意味着：在两种对现有证据解释力等价的宇宙假设之间，以实践后果为仲裁者——保留能动性的假设胜出。这把宇宙论变成了决策论的前置：你相信世界是开放的还是封闭的，本身是一种有后果的信念选择（与 M-WJM-007 的分区判准衔接）。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: absolute idealism (Bradley, Royce) argued from 'the whole is greater than its parts, parts mean only within the whole' that the universe is one finished Absolute—local evil and local error digested by 'higher unity.' Elegant, untestable, and practically paralyzing: if all is already arranged in the Absolute, effort and responsibility are illusions. His solution: demote 'the world is one finished whole' to an untested hypothesis, replaced by an equally adequate unfinished one: the world is a pluralistic 'many' (each-form), existing unities only already-formed partial linkings; the future is open, additive, savable—and disasterable. 'The world may be being saved' explains present facts as well as 'the world is already perfect,' but preserves the meaning of action. Methodologically: between cosmic hypotheses of equal explanatory power, let practical consequence arbitrate—the agency-preserving hypothesis wins. Cosmology becomes a prelude to decision theory: believing the world open or closed is itself a consequential choice of belief (linking to M-WJM-007's partition criterion).
modes.source_chapter: 《多元的宇宙》最后讲『结论』与《信仰的意志》中『道德哲学家与道德生活』：『世界尚在创造之中』；『可能的世界是尚未结束的多』
modes.key_quote_zh: 世界尚在创造之中，尚未完成——它以零零散散的方式被增补着，正因如此，才为我们的努力留有余地。
modes.key_quote_en: The world is each-form and not all-form... it is still in the making, and the making is unfinished—hence room for our efforts.
process_zh: 识别一元化论证的结构：凡以『整体先于部分、部分需在整体中获得意义』消化局部反例的体系，登记其不可检验的绝对项
构造等价的未完成替代假设：同样解释现有事实，但把『已完成的统一』改写为『已形成的局部联结+开放的未来』
以实践后果仲裁两个等价假设：比较二者对行动、责任、改进可能性的含义——保留能动性的假设胜出
把多元假设当作工作承诺执行：按『世界可被局部改进』行动，允许局部失败与局部拯救并存，拒绝用整体论把局部失败合理化
process_en: Identify the monistic argument-structure: any system digesting local counterexamples by 'whole precedes parts, parts mean within the whole'—register its untestable Absolute-term
Construct an equivalent unfinished alternative: explaining the same facts, but rewriting 'completed unity' as 'formed partial linkages plus an open future'
Arbitrate the two equivalent hypotheses by practical consequence: compare their implications for action, responsibility, improvability—the agency-preserving one wins

Execute the pluralist hypothesis as a working commitment: act on 'the world is locally improvable,' allow local failure and local saving to coexist, and refuse holistic rationalization of local failure
representative_cases_zh: 对绝对唯心论的正面战斗（1907-1909 与罗伊斯的公开论辩）：『绝对中一切都被安排』解释力与『世界正在被拯救』完全等价，但后者保留责任的实在性
『道德哲学家与道德生活』：在一个未完成的道德宇宙中，每个行动都在给世界的道德总量加或减——道德义务因此不依赖于已完成的世界秩序，而依赖可增补性本身
彻底经验主义的宇宙版（衔接 M-WJM-005）：联结是局部逐对形成的，不需要整体一次性担保——『多』本就自带部分统一，无须雇佣『一』当保镖
反例警示：实用主义被庸俗化为『怎么都行』的相对主义——多元论不是取消标准，而是把裁决权从想象的整体下放到可检验的局部后果；放弃局部裁决才真正取消了标准
representative_cases_en: The frontal battle with absolute idealism (the 1907-1909 public debate with Royce): 'all is arranged in the Absolute' and 'the world is being saved' are exactly equivalent in explanatory power, but the latter preserves the reality of responsibility

'The Moral Philosopher and the Moral Life': in an unfinished moral universe every act adds to or subtracts from the world's moral sum—obligation thus depends not on a completed world-order but on addability itself

The cosmic version of radical empiricism (continuing M-WJM-005): connections form locally, pair by pair, needing no one-shot guarantee by the whole—'the many' carries its partial unities within, no need to hire 'the One' as bodyguard

Cautionary case: pragmatism vulgarized into 'anything goes' relativism—pluralism does not cancel standards but devolves adjudication from an imagined whole to testable local consequences; abandoning local adjudication is what truly cancels standards
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革：以『系统可局部改进』假设替代『整体战略已定』神话——局部试点允许失败并存，拒绝用宏大叙事合理化失败
长期主义评估：把『历史有确定方向』当作不可检验假设悬置，改以局部可改善性作为行动依据
复杂系统治理：按『系统未完成、可增补』设计干预——小步增补+保留回退，反对一次性总体设计
科研选题：在一元大理论与多元局部机制间优先可检验的局部机制，大理论按兑现后果持续再估值
modern_applications_en: Organizational change: replace the myth of 'the grand strategy is settled' with 'the system is locally improvable'—pilots may fail alongside successes; refuse grand-narrative rationalization of failure
Long-termism assessment: suspend 'history has a fixed direction' as untestable; act on local improvability instead
Complex-system governance: design interventions as if the system were unfinished and additive—small increments with reversibility, against one-shot total design
Research topic selection: prefer testable local mechanisms over monistic grand theories; re-estimate grand theories continuously by cashed consequences

modes.name_zh: 第二次呼吸能量释放法
modes.domain_zh: 人体能量与意志极限/超越自认疲惫阈限
modes.domain_en: Human Energy and Limits of Will / Beyond the Felt Fatigue Threshold
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：疲惫感被当作身体资源耗尽的可靠指标——『我再也跑不动了』被读成生理事实。但他在《人的能量》（1907）中汇编证据：疲惫的『第一次力竭』是大脑的防护性信号而非真实储备耗尽——越过它，运动员、士兵、母亲出现『第二次呼吸』（second wind），能量在更大剂量上重新可得；人的日常只动用了可能能量的一小部分。疲惫是『习惯性节余线』的保守估算，阈限本身是可谈判的。方法上这意味着：把主观极限信号从『事实报告』重新归类为『保守估计』，以受控方式试探阈限外的真实储备，同时保留防护信号的安全职能——极限是估计值而非墙壁，但估计值的存在有理由，重估须有程序。这与 M-WJM-003（习惯刻痕）构成一体两面：习惯既可能刻得太浅，自认的极限也会刻得太深。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: fatigue was taken as a reliable index of depleted bodily resources—'I cannot run another step' read as physiological fact. But in The Energies of Men (1907) he assembled evidence: the first 'exhaustion' is the brain's protective signal, not real depletion—beyond it athletes, soldiers, and mothers find 'second wind,' energy available again in larger measure; habitually we use only a fraction of possible energy. Fatigue is a conservative estimate drawn at the habit-line; the threshold is negotiable. Methodologically: reclassify subjective limit-signals from 'fact reports' to 'conservative estimates,' probe the reserves beyond the threshold under controlled conditions while preserving the protective signal's safety function—limits are estimates, not walls, but the estimates exist for reasons and re-estimation needs procedure. This is the twin of M-WJM-003 (habit-carving): habits may be carved too shallow, and self-acknowledged limits carved too deep.
modes.source_chapter: 《人的能量》(The Energies of Men, 1907) 与《与教师谈心理学》论习惯与意志：第二次呼吸现象汇编；『我们只活在可能能量的利息之内』
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们日常生活所能动用的，只是可能能量的利息——本金从未动过。
modes.key_quote_en: Compared with what we ought to be, we are only half awake... the human individual thus lives usually far within his powers.
process_zh: 登记自报极限信号（『做不动了』），归类为保守估计而非事实——并为其保留作为防护回路的资格
在受控条件下设计越过阈限的小程序：短暂续推（再跑400米、再写一节），观察第二次呼吸是否出现、身体反馈是否恶化
区分两类反馈：疲惫感的持续（可谈判）与损伤信号（不可谈判）——只对前者续推，为后者设硬止损
把验证过的新阈限刻成新基线（衔接 M-WJM-003 的通路刻痕）：以稳定的小幅超越重估节余线，而非一次性透支
process_en: Register self-reported limit-signals ('I can't go on') as conservative estimates, not facts—while retaining their standing as protective circuitry
Design a small controlled program to cross the threshold: a brief continuation (400 more meters, one more section), observing whether second wind appears and whether bodily feedback worsens
Distinguish two feedback classes: persistent fatigue (negotiable) versus damage signals (non-negotiable)—continue only past the former, with hard stops for the latter
Carve the verified new threshold as the new baseline (continuing M-WJM-003's pathway-carving): re-estimate the reserve line by stable small overshoots, never one-shot overdraft
representative_cases_zh: 第二次呼吸的现象汇编：士兵夜行军力竭后闻号声再行二十里、产妇在极端疼痛后进入超常耐力期——能量在越过阈限后以更大剂量重新可得
『利息与本金』的估计论：日常耗竭如只花利息——与当时刚兴起的能量守恒生理学衔接，把『超常发挥』从神迹改写为储备动员的生理学
教育应用（Talks to Teachers）：让学生习惯于在自报极限后多坚持一段，把『极限可谈』刻成学习习惯——意志教育即阈限重估教育
反例警示：二十世纪的过劳文化把『再坚持一下』无限化——詹姆斯的程序里『损伤信号硬止损』被删掉，阈限重估退化成自我压榨：估计可谈判，但墙不存在不等于墙外没有深渊
representative_cases_en: The second-wind anthology: soldiers marching twenty more miles after 'exhaustion' at the bugle-call, mothers entering extraordinary endurance after extreme labor—energy re-available in larger measure beyond the threshold

The 'interest and principal' estimate: daily exhaustion spends only interest—aligned with the new physiology of energy conservation, rewriting 'superhuman effort' from miracle into the physiology of reserve mobilization

Educational use (Talks to Teachers): accustom students to hold on a while past self-reported limits, carving 'limits are negotiable' into study habit—education of the will as education of threshold re-estimation

Cautionary case: twentieth-century overwork culture infinite-ized 'push a little more'—deleting the hard-stop on damage signals from James's procedure, degrading threshold re-estimation into self-exploitation: estimates are negotiable, but no walls does not mean no abyss beyond them
modern_applications_zh: 训练科学：极化训练与耐力阈值重估——以受控超负荷刺激动员储备，配合损伤监测（心率变异、肌酸激酶）执行硬止损
深度工作：把『专注力竭』第一信号当保守估计，续推15分钟试探二次专注，同时为决策疲劳类损伤设硬止损
危机管理：团队自报极限时由指挥者区分疲惫与损伤，组织受控续推而非立即放弃任务
产品性能工程：以降级模式替代停机——系统『超载告警』第一阈值当作保守估计，分级降载而非一刀切断
modern_applications_en: Training science: polarized training and endurance-threshold re-estimation—controlled overload to mobilize reserves, with damage monitoring (HRV, creatine kinase) enforcing hard stops
Deep work: treat the first 'focus exhaustion' signal as a conservative estimate; push 15 more minutes to probe secondary focus, with hard stops for decision-fatigue-type damage
Crisis management: when teams self-report limits, commanders distinguish fatigue from damage and organize controlled continuation instead of instant mission abandonment
Performance engineering: degraded modes instead of shutdown—treat the first overload alarm as a conservative estimate, step down in grades rather than cut at once

modes.category: 写作技法/抽象论证的可读性转译
modes.domain_zh: 哲学写作/以经验描述与情绪质地承载抽象论证
modes.domain_en: Philosophical Writing / Carrying Abstract Argument in Experiential Description and Emotional Texture
modes.definition_zh: 詹姆斯面对的困难是：哲学论证的抽象与读者的经验隔离——绝对唯心论者的著作逻辑严密却无人能读进去，哲学成了圈子内的行话游戏。他的解法是双层写作：底层是论证的严格骨架（与同行可辩驳的形式），表层是经验描述与情绪质地——用读者身体里已有的经验（晕船、剧院散场、清晨起床的挣扎）作为抽象概念的落地锚点。『那可爱的绝对』式的修辞不是装饰而是论证的一部分：让读者先在经验中认出被讨论的现象，论证才有落点。他不牺牲严格性（每篇都可供专业反驳），但拒绝让严格性与可读性二选一。方法上这意味着：抽象内容的传播力取决于能否找到读者经验中的锚点——先给经验，再给概念，概念才被拥有而不是被背诵。这是实用主义原则在文体上的应用：写作的真实性也以读者的经验兑现为判据。
modes.definition_en: James faced this difficulty: philosophical argument is cut off from readers' experience—the absolute idealists' works were logically rigorous yet unreadable, philosophy a jargon-game for initiates. His solution: two-layer writing. The base layer is the rigorous skeleton of argument (in a form contestable by peers); the surface layer is experiential description and emotional texture—using experiences readers already have in their bodies (seasickness, theater crowds dispersing, the morning struggle to rise) as landing anchors for abstract concepts. Rhetoric like 'that lovely Absolute' is not ornament but part of the argument: let readers first recognize the phenomenon in experience, and the argument acquires a landing point. He never sacrifices rigor (every piece is professionally refutable) but refuses to choose between rigor and readability. Methodologically: the transmission power of abstract content depends on finding anchors in readers' experience—give experience first, concept second, so the concept is owned rather than recited. This is pragmatism applied to style: a text's truth, too, is judged by its cash-value in the reader's experience.
modes.source_chapter: 《实用主义》全书风格与《与教师谈心理学》的自述方法：以听众经验为讲课起点；书信中对『把哲学写得人人能读』的自我要求
modes.key_quote_zh: 哲学的终极功能应当是找出：若这个或那个世界公式为真，在生活的特定时刻，它对你我将造成何种确定的差别。
modes.key_quote_en: The whole function of philosophy ought to be to find out what definite difference it will make to you and me, at definite instants of our life, if this world-formula or that world-formula be the true one.
process_zh: 先搭严格论证骨架：论点、论据、可被同行反驳的形式——底层结构按专业标准完成，不因可读性打折
为每个关键抽象概念寻找读者经验中的锚点：普遍身体经验（疲惫、恐惧、社交尴尬）优先于局部文化经验
以经验描述开路、概念随后落地：段落以场景或情绪质地起笔，抽象词在经验被认出之后才出现——先认领现象，再命名现象
用嘴稿检验兑现：讲台或朗读测试文本——听众在何处走神即概念未兑现处，回头补锚点而非删论证
process_en: First build the rigorous skeleton: thesis, evidence, in a form contestable by peers—the base structure finished to professional standard, never discounted for readability
Find experiential anchors in the reader for every key abstraction: universal bodily experiences (fatigue, fear, social awkwardness) before local cultural ones

Lead with description, land the concept after: paragraphs open with scene or emotional texture; the abstract word appears only after the experience is recognized—claim the phenomenon first, name it second
Test cash-value aloud: podium or read-aloud trials—wherever listeners drift is where a concept failed to cash in; go back and add anchors rather than cut argument
representative_cases_zh: 《实用主义》的月台比喻与信用货币类比：真理观的全部论证被装进『旅行者与月台』的日常场景——哲学史上最畅销的哲学讲演由此而来
《宗教经验之种种》以证词原文为主语，作者分析退居注释位：让皈依者自己的语言携带论证——第一人称文本成为哲学论证材料的方法创举
对绝对唯心论的战斗檄文：『那可爱的绝对啊』式反讽修辞与严格逻辑论证并置——情绪质地使立场差异在读者身体里可感
反例警示：学术期刊化时代的哲学写作只保留骨架层，锚点层被当作不严肃删除——结果同行互读、公众绝迹：只有骨架的写作在同行内兑现，在人类经验中违约
representative_cases_en: The railway-platform and credit-currency analogies of Pragmatism: the entire truth-theory packed into everyday scenes of the traveler and the platform—hence the best-selling philosophical lectures in history

The Varieties letting testimonies be the subject, the author's analysis retreating to commentary: the converts' own language carries the argument—a methodological innovation of first-person text as philosophical evidence
The polemics against absolute idealism: 'that lovely Absolute' irony set beside rigorous logic—emotional texture making the stakes felt in the reader's body

Cautionary case: the journal-era of academic philosophy kept only the skeleton and deleted the anchor layer as unserious—peers read peers while the public vanished: a skeleton-only text cashes within the guild and defaults on human experience
modern_applications_zh: 技术写作：每个抽象机制配一个用户身体经验的类比锚点（缓存=桌面便签），骨架层保持工程严谨
学术传播：论文摘要与公众号版本双层生产——骨架不变，锚点层按受众经验重铸
产品文案：先描述使用场景的身体感受，再出现功能名词——先认领现象再命名现象
教学设计：每节以学生已有经验开场（昨天的食堂、上周的考试），概念在经验被认出后引入
modern_applications_en: Technical writing: pair every abstract mechanism with an anchor from bodily experience (cache = desk sticky-notes), keeping the skeleton layer engineering-rigorous
Scholarly communication: two-layer production of paper abstracts and public-facing versions—same skeleton, anchor layer recast to each audience's experience
Product copy: describe the bodily feel of the use scene first, functional nouns after—claim the phenomenon before naming it
Instructional design: open each session with experience students already have (yesterday's canteen, last week's exam); introduce concepts only after the experience is recognized
